 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>REGISTRATION OF ADDITIONAL ORDINARY SHARES PURSUANT TO GENERAL INSTRUCTION E </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:8%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Registration Statement is being filed pursuant to General Instruction E to Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">S-8</FONT> under the
Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &#147;Securities Act&#148;). The contents of the Registration Statements on Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">S-8</FONT> previously filed by Constellium N.V. (the &#147;Registrant&#148;) with the
Securities and Exchange Commission (the &#147;Commission&#148;) on October&nbsp;25, 2013 (File <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">No.&nbsp;333-191905)</FONT> and December&nbsp;19, 2014 (File <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">No.&nbsp;333-201141)</FONT>
(together, the &#147;Prior Registration Statements&#148;) are incorporated by reference herein and made a part hereof. As was approved by the Registrant&#146;s shareholders at the Registrant&#146;s Annual General Meeting held on May&nbsp;24, 2018,
this Registration Statement on Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">S-8</FONT> is filed by the Registrant to register an additional 7,000,000 shares of the Registrant&#146;s ordinary shares, nominal value &#128;0.02 per share, which may be awarded
under the Constellium N.V. 2013 Equity Incentive Plan (as amended, the &#147;Plan&#148;), which ordinary shares are additional securities of the same class as other securities issuable under the Plan previously filed with the Commission with the
Prior Registration Statements. As of the filing of this Registration Statement on Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">S-8,</FONT> up to 14,292,291 ordinary shares may be awarded under the Plan. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:24pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>PART II </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>INFORMATION

 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">2 </P>

laws; </TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

(ii)&nbsp;as at the date of issuance of any Shares under the Plan, and (b)&nbsp;any rights to subscribe for the Shares under the Plan have been validly granted; </TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(d)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">that any Shares will be issued, paid and duly accepted (a)&nbsp;as contemplated in and in accordance with the Plan and the Registration Statement, (b)&nbsp;in accordance with any applicable law (including, without
limitation, the laws of the Netherlands), (c) in accordance with the articles of association of the Company as in force at the date of issuance of such Shares and (d)&nbsp;with such terms so as not to violate any applicable law (including, for the
avoidance of doubt, any law applicable at the time of such issue, offer, delivery or acceptance) and upon issue of each Share at least a consideration (in cash or in kind) will be paid to the Company on such Share with a value equal to the nominal
amount thereof and any premium agreed upon; </TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(e)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">that the Company has not been declared bankrupt (<I>failliet verklaard</I>), granted suspension of payments (<I>surseance van betaling verleend</I>) or dissolved (<I>ontbonden</I>), nor has ceased to exist due to merger
(<I>fusie</I>) or demerger (<I>splitsing</I>); although not constituting conclusive evidence, this assumption is supported by the contents of the Extract and by our online search of the Central Insolvency Register of the courts in the Netherlands
(<I>Centraal Insolventieregister</I>) on the date hereof, which did not reveal any information which would render this assumption to be untrue; </TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(f)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">that each time a Share is issued, the authorised share capital (<I>maatschappelijk kapitaal</I>) of the Company is sufficient for such Share to be validly issued; </TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(g)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">that the information set forth in the Extract is complete and accurate on the date hereof and consistent with the information contained in the Trade Register with respect to the Company; </TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(h)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">that the Resolutions have not been annulled, revoked or rescinded and are in full force and effect as at the date hereof; </TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(i)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">that any issuance of Shares will not require the Company to publish a prospectus or equivalent document under the provisions of chapter 5.1 of the Financial Supervision Act, as amended; and </TD></TR></TABLE>
 <p STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt ; font-size:8pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">3 </P>

<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(j)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">that none of the insolvency proceedings listed in Annex A, as amended, to Regulation (EU) 2015/848 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 20&nbsp;May 2015 on insolvency proceedings has been declared applicable
to the Company by a court in one of the member states of the EU (with the exception of Denmark), other than the Netherlands; although not constituting conclusive evidence, this assumption is supported by our online search of the section on EU
Registrations of the Central Insolvency Register (<I>Centraal Insolventieregister</I>) on the date hereof, which did not reveal any information which would render this assumption to be untrue. </TD></TR></TABLE>

courts of the Netherlands and in administrative rulings, in each case published in printed form as at the date of this opinion. We do not express any opinion with respect to (i)&nbsp;any public international law or the rules of or promulgated under
any treaty or by any treaty organisation, other than any provisions of EU law having direct effect, (ii)&nbsp;matters of competition law, and (iii)&nbsp;matters of taxation. </TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

revealed by the documents reviewed by us in the course of our examination referred to above, we are as at the date hereof of the following opinion: </TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="4%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(a)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">the Company has been duly incorporated, and is validly existing under the laws of the Netherlands as a public limited company (<I>naamloze</I><I> </I><I>vennootschap</I>); and </TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>

 <BODY BGCOLOR="WHITE">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 99.2 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>AMENDMENT TO THE </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>CONSTELLIUM N.V. </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>2013&nbsp;EQUITY INCENTIVE PLAN </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><I>(effective as of May 24, 2018) </I></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, Constellium N.V., a Netherlands <I>naamloze vennootschap</I> (the &#147;<U>Company</U>&#148;), has adopted the Constellium N.V.
2013&nbsp;Equity Incentive Plan (the &#147;<U>Plan</U>&#148;); </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, the Board of Directors of the Company (the
&#147;<U>Board</U>&#148;) and the shareholders of the Company previously approved an increase to the number of Class&nbsp;A ordinary shares, par value &#128;0.02 (&#147;<U>Shares</U>&#148;), reserved for issuance under Section&nbsp;3(a) of the Plan
from 5,292,291 to 7,292,291&nbsp;Shares in connection with the Company&#146;s Annual General Meeting held in June&nbsp;2014; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, the
Board and the shareholders of the Company approved another increase to the number of Shares reserved under Section&nbsp;3(a) of the Plan from 7,292,291 to 14,292,291&nbsp;Shares in connection with the Company&#146;s Annual General Meeting held in
May&nbsp;2018; and </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, the Board desires to document such increases to the Share reserve under the Plan. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">NOW, THEREFORE, pursuant to Section&nbsp;12(c) of the Plan, the Plan is hereby amended as follows: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1. <U>Increase of Number of Shares Available for Award</U>. The first sentence of Section&nbsp;3(a) of the Plan is hereby amended by replacing
&#147;5,292,291&#148; with &#147;14,292,291&#148;. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2. <U>Miscellaneous</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:8%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(a) <U>Full Force and Effect</U>. Except as expressly amended by this Amendment, all terms and conditions of the Plan and any awards thereunder
shall remain in full force and effect. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:8%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">(b) <U>Governing Law</U>. This Amendment shall be governed by the substantive laws, but not the
choice of law rules, of the Netherlands. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><I>Approved by the Board of Directors of Constellium N.V. </I></P>
